description: Right-side layers panel for managing diagram layers.

parameters.name: ShowCollapseToggle
parameters.description: When false, the panel renders without its own collapse tab and fills its host's width — for hosts (TmDiagramEditor's inspector) that own the collapse. Default true (standalone use).

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the panel renders its own heading. Hosts that already label the panel (a tab, a sheet tab) pass false. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: RowMenuPresentation
parameters.description: How each row's "⋯" menu presents on a narrow viewport — handed to the core TmContextMenu.MobilePresentation. Default Auto resolves from the viewport scope (content-height bottom sheet on a phone, anchored popover otherwise). TmDiagramEditor passes Sheet on its mobile layout and Popover elsewhere.
